name: Shop Pay
summary: Shopify's stored-details checkout. Agents reach it through Shopify's agent tooling (UCP, Catalog and checkout MCP tools, WebMCP in the browser), and can complete Shop Pay checkouts once the buyer authorizes the purchase.
facts: UCP with Catalog, Cart and Checkout MCP; WebMCP checkout tools
Order placed only after buyer authorization
No extra fee with Shopify Payments
goodFor: Buyers who already have Shop Pay saved
watchOut: Direct checkout completion is gated by agent trust tiers
